text:
From your other post you applied in Israel while he's waiting abroad, right?
They need your proof of address in Israel.
As you just came back you can of course add the proof from Korea as well.
Sometimes these emails about missing documents are standard , not necessarily that they didn't receive it.
You can try to email them the requested documents or go to MH (with the necessary documents) and make sure what they are missing.
Good luck 🙏
